name: automation
description: When I want to interact with a web element, such as filling a username field, I first identify the element using the browser's Inspect/DevTools to understand its attributes.  In Playwright, I can use page.locator() with a CSS selector such as an ID or class. Alternatively, Playwright provides built-in user-facing locators such as getByRole(), getByLabel(), and getByTestId(), which allow me to locate elements without necessarily using a CSS selector.
